properties.name: zcm.sdk.service.name
properties.description: Logical service name (map to spring.application.name & consul service)

properties.name: zcm.sdk.instance.id
properties.description: Instance ID override

properties.name: zcm.sdk.config.server.url
properties.description: Spring Cloud Config Server base URL (mapped to spring.config.import=configserver:...)

properties.name: zcm.sdk.discovery.provider
properties.description: Discovery provider (CONSUL or CONTROL). Default CONSUL

properties.name: zcm.sdk.discovery.consul.heartbeat.enabled
properties.description: Enable Consul TTL heartbeat (mapped to spring.cloud.consul.discovery.heartbeat.enabled)

properties.name: zcm.sdk.discovery.consul.heartbeat.ttl
properties.description: Consul TTL value (mapped to spring.cloud.consul.discovery.heartbeat.ttl)

properties.name: zcm.sdk.lb.policy
properties.description: LB policy hint for choose()

properties.name: zcm.sdk.ping.enabled
properties.description: Enable scheduled ping to ConfigControlService

properties.name: zcm.sdk.ping.fixed-delay
properties.description: Fixed delay (ms) for scheduled ping

properties.name: zcm.sdk.ping.hash-mock.enabled
properties.description: Enable mock config hash generation for load testing. When enabled, SDK generates deterministic mock hashes matching server-side strategy to avoid drift events.

properties.name: zcm.sdk.ping.hash-mock.strategy
properties.description: Mock hash strategy: DETERMINISTIC (stable hash for same service:env), RANDOM (varies each time), STATIC (fixed hash value)

properties.name: zcm.sdk.ping.hash-mock.static-hash
properties.description: Static hash value used when strategy is STATIC

properties.name: zcm.sdk.control.url
properties.description: ConfigControlService base URL (e.g., http://ctrl:8080)

properties.name: zcm.sdk.bus.refresh.enabled
properties.description: Enable Kafka listener for config refresh

properties.name: zcm.sdk.bus.kafka.bootstrap-servers
properties.description: Kafka bootstrap servers for refresh listener

properties.name: zcm.sdk.kv.enabled
properties.description: Enable Key-Value store functionality

properties.name: zcm.sdk.client-credentials.required
properties.description: Whether client credentials authentication is required for M2M authentication (used by both ping and KV operations)

properties.name: zcm.sdk.client-credentials.client-id
properties.description: Keycloak client ID for client credentials flow (required). Obtained from service credentials after approval. Used by both ping and KV operations.

properties.name: zcm.sdk.client-credentials.client-secret
properties.description: Keycloak client secret for client credentials flow (required). Obtained from service credentials after approval. Must be kept secure. Used by both ping and KV operations.

properties.name: zcm.sdk.client-credentials.token-endpoint
properties.description: Keycloak token endpoint URL (optional). If not provided, SDK will auto-discover from config-control-service. Format: http://keycloak:8080/realms/{realm}/protocol/openid-connect/token

properties.name: zcm.sdk.client-credentials.keycloak-base-url
properties.description: Keycloak base URL for fallback token endpoint construction (optional). Used if token-endpoint is not provided and auto-discovery fails. Example: http://keycloak:8080

properties.name: zcm.sdk.client-credentials.realm
properties.description: Keycloak realm name (optional, default: config-control). Used for token endpoint construction if needed.

properties.name: zcm.sdk.api-key.enabled
properties.description: Enable API key authentication for SDK requests to config-control-service

properties.name: zcm.sdk.api-key.key
properties.description: API key value to send in X-API-Key header for authentication
